facts.title: roasted eggplant with tomatoes and mint
ingredients: 1 to 2 tablespoons plus 4 teaspoons olive oil
1 1/2 pounds eggplant (about 2 medium), in 3/4- to 1-inch slices
2 ounces (1/2 cup) chopped or crumbled ricotta salata
facts.yield_text: Makes about 4 appetizer/salad portions, assuming people will eat two rounds each.
facts.author: Deb Perelman
